native_baseline.scope: Saved file baseline only; no live DB access or future CAS/lease authorization.

additional_reading.semantics: producer additional-reading record time; not publication/retrieval/DB first-save

next_job_workflow.trigger: Only next genuinely new eligible saved source or actual existing management-date job. No fake source/config/date, no completed-job replay.
next_job_workflow.authority: Observedv3 is historical. Root gives the then-current authoritative packet/head/CAS/worker/generation/unexpired lease plus this handoff. This ticket grants no execution/completion right.
next_job_workflow.source_vs_context: Additional9/11/12 reading and raw-DPS records are dated old-source known context; not newly published sources/pending evidence. No automatic attachment/authentication.
next_job_workflow.source_reviews: Exactly once per actual frozen pending source using its own snapshot/quote. Do not add oldQ1 source or file-only candidates as pending.
next_job_workflow.case_observation_evidence_source_ids: Only actual frozen pending IDs. Narrative references do not widen the evidence IDs.
next_job_workflow.summary_and_case_observation_required_co: Both summary and case_observation.rationale retain prior split/DPS/benefit/acquisition known facts, then explicitly name additional-read time/ref/SHA/source nativeSHA and newly resolved tax method/CF nonpreparation/individual thousand-unit periods/contract-change/carryforward definitions; separate P1/P2/C1–C3/I1 residuals. source_reviews.rationale alone is not projected by next prior_review.
next_job_workflow.minor_wording: Issuer outlook of minor effect on FY2027 consolidated results; not measured acquisition contribution, quantitative threshold or zero.
next_job_workflow.due_only_empty_pending: source_reviews/evidence_source_ids remain empty. Old context alone cannot support supports/counterevidence. Due review sets a supported future management date or unsets with reason; no outcome/date predecided here.
next_job_workflow.question_preparation: Remove K1–K8 known answers before any question. Unreadp10 is a saved public-check target, not company nonresponse. Company definitions and investor normal/forecast/price assumptions differ; IRvalueunproven/financialbranchesnull persist unless separately established.
next_job_workflow.receipt_limits: No automatic discovery/attachment/typed supplemental evidence/receipt guarantee. Root/independent reviewer checks actual reading and meaning/context separation before complete. ResultSHA freezes narrative, not external-content machine validation.
